description: OOMOL File is a toolkit that provides basic modules for handling files and folders in your OOMOL workflow. Whether you need to download files from the internet, copy documents between folders, or convert data into files, these modules make the operations simple and intuitive.
save-the-binary-data-as-target-file: Save the binary data as target file
download-html-file-from-url-as-binary: Download HTML file from URL as binary
save-the-binary-data-as-target-file2: Save the binary data as target file
save-the-binary-data-as-temp-file: Save the binary data as temp file
read-names-of-file-in-local-folder-then-:
Read names of file in local folder.
Then you can see the name list in log panel.
read-file-from-local-file-path-then-you-:
Read file from local file path.
Then you can see the downloaded binary data in log panel.
read-html-file-from-url-then-you-can-see:
Read HTML file from URL.
Then you can see the downloaded binary data in log panel.
write-binary-content-to-a-file: Write binary content to a file
save-the-file-path-if-left-blank-specify: Save the file path. If left blank, specify a specific address, the suffix of which is the same as the suffix setting (if this field has a value)
specify-the-file-suffix-when-the-file_pa: Specify the file suffix when the file_path is not set
write-binary-content-to-a-file2: Write binary content to a file
the-converted-file-save-folder-path: The converted file save folder path
whether-to-create-the-folder-if-it-does-: Whether to create the folder if it does not exist
what-to-do-when-a-file-already-exists-at: What to do when a file already exists at the save path?
delete-all-contents-in-the-folder: Delete all contents in the folder
read-binary-contents-of-a-file: Read binary contents of a file
read-binary-contents-of-a-file2: Read binary contents of a file
sort-files-by-filename-using-natural-sor: Sort files by filename using natural sort
if-enabled-the-absolute-path-is-returned: If enabled, the absolute path is returned. If disabled, the path relative to the folder is returned.
initiate-an-http-request-to-download-the: Initiate an HTTP request to download the contents of the URL and return it in binary format
Initiate an HTTP request to download the content of the URL and save it to a file.
specify-the-folder-path-where-the-file-w: Specify the folder path where the file will be saved. If it does not exist, specify a specific path.
whether-to-rename-the-downloaded-file-na: Whether to rename the downloaded file name. If false, the file name in the URL will be retained.
read-the-file-content-and-encode-it-into: Read the file content and encode it into a string
the-decoding-format-of-the-string-if-not: The decoding format of the string, if not filled, it will be automatically recognized
initiate-a-request-to-download-the-conte: Initiate a request to download the content of a URL and parse it into a string. It can be used to read the content of a URL such as HTML, XML, etc. If the URL corresponding to the content is not a string (such as an image or audio file), an error will be reported.
the-encoding-format-to-use-to-parse-the-: The encoding format to use to parse the request content. If left unfilled, the format will be automatically determined.
